question: How did the Israelites treat Gideon's family after his death?
options: They made his son Jether their king
They gave his family the land of Midian
They built a tomb for each of his sons
They failed to show kindness to his family for all the good he had done
explanation: The Israelites forgot the LORD and failed to show any kindness to the family of Jerub-Baal (Gideon) for all the good things he had done for them.
